Khawsa

.cook
📖 zbhoy.notion.site

🥘 Ingredients

  • chicken
    1 whole
  • coconut milk
    1 can
  • garlic paste
    3 tablespoons
  • ginger paste
    3 tablespoons
  • oil
  • onion
    1-1.5
  • red pepper powder
    1/2 tablespoon
  • salt
  • water

🍳 Cookware

  • pot
  • lid
  1. 1
    Chop onion and blend to paste (using chop setting).
    onion: 1-1.5
  2. 2
    Put into a pot , high heat, and cook water off (optional add some salt ).
    salt
  3. 3
    Add oil and reduce heat to medium. Cook more till pink.
    oil
  4. 4
    Add ginger paste and garlic paste (adrak and lassan), red pepper powder , and some salt and cook. Add oil if necessary.
    ginger paste: 3 tablespoons, garlic paste: 3 tablespoons, red pepper powder: 1/2 tablespoon, salt, oil
  5. 5
    Add chicken (whole chicken cut into 8 pieces) and cook. Add oil if needed.
    chicken: 1 whole, oil
  6. 6
    Cook the chicken until brown.
    chicken
  7. 7
    Add water (one glass ish). Cover with a lid and cook the chicken .
    water, chicken
  8. 8
    Add coconut milk and cook. Taste and add more coconut milk if needed.
    coconut milk: 1 can, coconut milk
